title: Validate Successful LTE Attach and Detach with Single UE under Excellent Radio Conditions
preconditions: Single LTE cell is activated and unloaded; all other cells are powered off.
One UE (real or emulated) is placed at cell center under excellent LTE RSRP conditions as per Clause 4.6.
Test configuration parameters are recorded.
testSteps: Configure the test setup as per the test configuration.
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON the UE and wait for successful LTE attach (3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1).
Verify UE is attached to the correct cell by checking PCI, Global eNB ID, and ARFCN from UE logs.
Power OFF the UE and wait for successful LTE detach (3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.8.2.1).
Validate signaling connection release by confirming UE context release and RRC connection release messages.
Stop and save logs.
Repeat the attach-detach cycle 10 times, recording attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency.
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures succeed 10 consecutive times with 100% success rate.
Attach latency values (min, average, max) are within acceptable limits.
Signaling message flows conform to the referenced 3GPP specifications.
verificationMethods: Check UE logs for attach/detach success messages and cell identifiers.
Analyze captured signaling logs for correct message sequences and releases.
Calculate and record KPIs in Table 5-2 and Table 5-3.

title: Validate Successful 5G NSA Attach and Detach with Single UE including Secondary Node Addition and Release
preconditions: Single 5G NSA cell (LTE Master Node + 5G Secondary Node) is activated and unloaded; other cells are powered off.
One UE (real or emulated) is placed at cell center under excellent 5G SS-RSRP conditions as per Clause 4.6.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Configure the test setup according to the test configuration.
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON the UE and wait for successful 5G NSA attach and Secondary Node addition (3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1 and TS 37.340 Clause 10.2.1).
Verify UE attachment to correct LTE and 5G cells by checking PCI, Global eNB/gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN in UE logs.
Power OFF the UE and wait for successful detach and Secondary Node release (3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.8.2.1 and TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1).
Validate signaling connection release including UE context release and RRC connection release messages for both MN and SN.
Stop and save logs.
Repeat the attach-detach cycle 10 times, recording attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, and detach success rate.
expectedResults: Attach, Secondary Node addition, and detach procedures succeed 10 consecutive times with 100% success rate.
Signaling message flows conform to referenced 3GPP specifications including Secondary Node release procedure.
KPIs recorded in Table 5-2 reflect expected performance.
verificationMethods: Check UE logs and applications for successful attach and secondary node addition.
Analyze signaling logs for correct message flow including SgNB addition and release messages.
Confirm 5G secondary node release per Clause 10.4.1 procedure.
Record KPIs and success rates.

title: Negative Test: LTE Attach Failure due to Poor Radio Conditions
preconditions: Single LTE cell activated and unloaded; other cells powered off.
UE (real or emulated) placed under poor LTE RSRP conditions below minimum coupling loss threshold.
testSteps: Configure test setup with poor radio conditions.
Start logging call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON UE to initiate LTE attach.
Wait for attach procedure to fail or timeout.
Power OFF UE.
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails or times out due to poor radio conditions.
Detach procedure not triggered or fails gracefully if triggered.
Logs show failed attach request without completion.
No UE context or RRC connection established.
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for failed attach messages.
Confirm absence of attach complete messages.
Check UE state to ensure it remains detached.

title: Negative Test: 5G NSA Secondary Node Release Rejection by SN
preconditions: 5G NSA cell activated with UE attached and Secondary Node established.
SN configured to reject Secondary Node Release requests to simulate SN change procedure.
testSteps: Initiate Secondary Node Release procedure from MN by sending SgNB Release Request.
Observe SN response rejecting the SN release.
Verify handling of rejection by MN and UE.
Power OFF UE to trigger detach.
Stop and save logs.
expectedResults: SN rejects the Secondary Node Release request as per simulated scenario.
MN handles rejection gracefully without crashing or resource leaks.
Secondary Node remains active until further action.
Detach procedure proceeds correctly after rejection scenario.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for SgNB Release Request and rejection message.
Verify MN reaction to rejection (e.g., canceling CPC or retrying).
Confirm UE context and SCG configuration remain valid until detach.

title: Edge Case Test: Attach-Detach with Minimum Coupling Loss Threshold at Radio Boundary
preconditions: Single LTE or 5G NSA cell activated and unloaded.
UE positioned exactly at the minimum coupling loss threshold defining excellent radio conditions.
testSteps: Configure test setup to achieve radio conditions at minimum coupling loss threshold.
Start logging.
Power ON UE and perform attach.
Verify attach success or failure.
Power OFF UE and perform detach.
Repeat attach-detach cycle 10 times.
Record all KPIs and any deviations.
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures succeed or fail consistently at the boundary condition.
KPIs reflect performance degradation or stability at threshold.
No unexpected behavior or intermittent failures.
verificationMethods: Measure and log LTE RSRP or 5G SS-RSRP values precisely.
Analyze attach/detach success rate and latency.
Compare KPIs with baseline from excellent radio conditions.

title: Edge Case Test: Attach Latency Measurement Extremes
preconditions: Test setup with excellent radio conditions and single UE.
Attach-detach procedure repeated 10 times to capture latency variance.
testSteps: Perform 10 attach-detach cycles as per standard procedure.
Measure attach latency for each iteration (time from attach request to attach complete).
Sort latency values in ascending order.
Record minimum, average, and maximum latency in Table 5-3.
expectedResults: Latency values show expected variance within acceptable range.
Attach latency min, avg, max values are correctly calculated and recorded.
No outlier latency values indicating performance issues.
verificationMethods: Review timing logs for precise attach latency measurements.
Confirm calculations of min, average, and max latency are correct.

title: Performance Test: Repeated Attach-Detach under Load with Single UE
preconditions: Single cell activated and unloaded.
One UE placed under excellent radio conditions.
Test environment capable of high-resolution timing and logging.
testSteps: Configure logging to capture detailed timing and signaling.
Perform 10 consecutive attach-detach cycles rapidly with the same UE.
Measure attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency for each iteration.
Analyze trends or degradation over iterations.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates remain at 100% throughout.
Attach latency remains stable without increase over iterations.
No resource exhaustion or failures observed during repeated cycles.
verificationMethods: Analyze KPI trends for latency and success rates over iterations.
Check system resource usage if possible.
Validate logs for any errors or warnings.

title: Security Test: Unauthorized UE Attempting Attach to Network
preconditions: Network configured with access control and authentication enabled.
UE with invalid credentials or unauthorized IMSI.
testSteps: Power ON unauthorized UE under excellent radio conditions.
Attempt LTE or 5G NSA attach procedure.
Observe network response to authentication failure.
Power OFF unauthorized UE.
Capture and save logs.
expectedResults: Attach request is rejected by network due to failed authentication.
Network does not allocate resources or establish UE context.
No signaling connection release messages for unauthorized UE.
Security logs record authentication failure event.
verificationMethods: Check network authentication logs and event records.
Analyze signaling logs for attach rejection messages.
Ensure no UE context is created for unauthorized UE.

title: Integration Test: Coordination between MN and SN during Secondary Node Release
preconditions: 5G NSA cell with MN and SN active and UE attached.
MN and SN connected and able to exchange release messages.
testSteps: Trigger Secondary Node Release procedure initiated by MN.
Verify MN sends SgNB Release Request and SN responds with SgNB Release Request Acknowledge.
Verify MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE for SCG release.
Confirm SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report to MN.
Confirm UE context release message is received by SN and SN releases resources.
Repeat procedure with SN initiated release and verify message flows.
Power OFF UE and save logs.
expectedResults: MN and SN coordinate release as per Clause 10.4.1 signaling flow.
All messages exchanged in correct sequence without errors.
UE releases SCG configuration correctly.
No resource leaks in MN or SN after release.
Data forwarding and usage reporting occur in expected order.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for message exchange sequences.
Verify timing and order of data forwarding and reporting messages.
Check UE logs for RRC reconfiguration and SCG release.
Confirm resource release on SN.

title: Usability Test: Clarity and Completeness of Test Report Documentation for Attach-Detach Test
preconditions: Test execution completed with logs and KPIs collected.
testSteps: Generate test report including configuration parameters, attach/detach success rates, latency metrics, and gap analysis.
Review report for clarity, completeness, and ease of understanding.
Verify that all required tables (5-2 and 5-3) are filled accurately.
Check that test setup and environment descriptions are detailed and understandable.
expectedResults: Test report is clear, complete, and easy to understand by all stakeholders.
All KPIs and configuration parameters are documented without ambiguity.
Gap analysis is presented with actionable insights.
Report format is consistent with organizational standards.
verificationMethods: Peer review of test report.
Feedback from test engineers and stakeholders.
Verification against test documentation templates.

title: Compatibility Test: Attach-Detach Test with Different UE Types (Real vs Emulated)
preconditions: Test environment supports both real and emulated UEs.
Single cell activated and unloaded.
testSteps: Perform attach-detach test with a real UE under excellent radio conditions.
Record all KPIs and success rates.
Repeat attach-detach test with emulated UE using the same configuration.
Compare KPIs and success rates between real and emulated UEs.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates are consistent between real and emulated UE.
Latency and other KPIs are within acceptable variance.
No unexpected failures or behavioral differences.
Test setup and procedure are compatible with both UE types.
verificationMethods: Compare logs and KPI tables for both UE types.
Analyze signaling message flows for consistency.
Confirm test procedure adaptability to UE types.

title: Compatibility Test: Attach-Detach Test in Lab (Shielded Environment) vs Field Setup
preconditions: Test setup available in lab with RF shielded environment and field with radiated antenna.
Single UE available.
testSteps: Perform attach-detach test in lab setup using variable attenuator/fading generator to ensure excellent radio conditions.
Record KPIs and logs.
Perform attach-detach test in field setup with UE placed at cell center near antenna.
Record KPIs and logs.
Compare results from lab and field environments.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates are 100% in both environments.
KPIs such as latency and RSRP values are comparable and within expected ranges.
No environment-specific failures or anomalies.
Test procedure is validated for both lab and field applicability.
verificationMethods: Analyze and compare KPI tables and logs from both environments.
Confirm radio condition metrics meet Clause 4.6 definitions in both setups.
Review any environment-specific notes or deviations.

title: Negative Test: UE Fails to Comply with RRCConnectionReconfiguration Message during Secondary Node Release
preconditions: 5G NSA cell with UE attached and Secondary Node active.
UE configured or forced to reject parts of RRCConnectionReconfiguration message during SN release.
testSteps: Initiate Secondary Node Release procedure (MN or SN initiated).
Send RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE instructing SCG release.
UE rejects part or all of the configuration in the message.
Observe UE performing reconfiguration failure procedure.
Power OFF UE and save logs.
expectedResults: UE performs reconfiguration failure procedure as specified.
Network handles failure gracefully without service disruption.
Proper signaling messages exchanged reflecting failure.
Resources are eventually released appropriately.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for reconfiguration failure messages.
Check UE logs for failure procedure execution.
Confirm network resource cleanup after failure.

title: Integration Test: Data Forwarding Coordination between MN and SN during Secondary Node Release
preconditions: 5G NSA cell with active MN and SN, UE attached with bearers using RLC AM.
Data forwarding configured.
testSteps: Initiate Secondary Node Release (MN initiated).
Verify timing coordination between SgNB Release Request and SN Status Transfer messages.
Observe data forwarding start from SN to MN.
Verify Secondary RAT Data Usage Report message sent to MN.
Repeat with SN initiated release and observe similar coordination.
Power OFF UE and save logs.
expectedResults: Data forwarding and reporting occur with correct timing to minimize service gaps.
SN sends SN Status Transfer before or concurrently with data forwarding.
Secondary RAT Data Usage Report sent without waiting for data forwarding to end.
No data loss or service interruption observed.
verificationMethods: Analyze detailed signaling and data forwarding logs.
Check timestamps of messages to confirm coordination.
Verify end-to-end data integrity.

title: Security Test: Verification of UE Context Release and Resource Cleanup on Detach
preconditions: UE attached to LTE or 5G NSA cell.
Network supports secure UE context and resource management.
testSteps: Power OFF UE to initiate UE-initiated detach.
Verify signaling messages for UE context release and RRC connection release.
Confirm resources associated with UE context are released promptly.
Attempt to reuse released resources and verify no unauthorized access occurs.
expectedResults: UE context and radio/C-plane resources are securely released upon detach.
No residual or ghost UE contexts remain.
Resource reallocation does not expose previous UE data or permissions.
Signaling logs confirm proper detach messaging.
verificationMethods: Check signaling logs for UE context release messages.
Monitor resource allocation tables for absence of stale entries.
Perform security scans for unauthorized access.

title: Usability Test: Ease of Configuring Test Setup and Recording Test Configuration
preconditions: Test engineer has access to test equipment and configuration interfaces.
testSteps: Configure single cell scenario with one active UE under excellent radio conditions.
Record all test configuration parameters in the test report.
Evaluate clarity and user-friendliness of configuration steps and recording process.
Attempt to reproduce configuration based only on recorded parameters.
expectedResults: Test setup configuration is straightforward and well documented.
All necessary parameters are captured accurately.
Reproduction of test setup from recorded parameters is successful.
Test documentation supports ease of use and minimal ambiguity.
verificationMethods: User feedback from test engineers.
Review of configuration records and reports.
Recreation of test setup from documentation.
